name: Harizome Shione
source:
The student council president of the school the protagonist attends. She is born into a prominent family and is the daughter of the school's executive director. 

She is always at the top of her class, has a fine figure, and seems to be picture-perfect and beautiful girl. But in reality, she is an extreme narcissist with too many faults in her personality and is obsessed with her perfect self.

She is popular and is often confessed to by male students, but when it comes to love, she's completely useless. She lives with Ao, the vice president of the school and her maid, and they have a sisterly relationship.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.asa-pro.com/koirowa/character/chara2.html]official website[/url]]
